summary: Full end-to-end verification of Sole Serenity after GitHub pull + env config. Ran 25 backend API tests (public endpoints, pricing, uploads, order lifecycle with SS-10001 sequential number, admin auth, admin CRUD, Stripe checkout gating before/after approval, manual label, status transitions, settings, FAQ/reviews CRUD) — all 25 passed (100%). Verified emails collection is written to with provider=mailgun and status=sent for shoes_received/label_ready etc. Admin routes correctly return 403 without token. Stripe test-mode checkout URL is generated only after approval and blocked (400) before. Frontend: home, services, how-it-works, delivery, faq, contact, /book multi-step, /track lookup, /admin/login, /admin dashboard, /admin/orders, /admin/settings all render and integrate with backend (data-testid coverage is comprehensive; SS-10001 visible in admin list; announcement banner reflects PUT /api/admin/settings). No blocking bugs found.

Frontend: Home, Services, How It Works, Delivery, FAQ, Contact render; Book page multi-step renders with data-testid; /track lookup exposes track-order-number/track-token testids; Admin login authenticates and redirects to /admin; Dashboard shows counts + Recent Orders (SS-10001); Orders page lists SS-10001; Settings page tabs render (Business/Pricing/Shipping/Social/Analytics/FAQ/Gallery/Integrations)
critical_code_review_comments: backend_test.py had a hardcoded BASE_URL from a previous preview host — updated to read from BACKEND_URL env with the current REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL as fallback so future iterations don't fail silently.
OrderTracking is only reachable via /order/:orderNumber (not bare /order); TrackLookup at /track is the guest entry point — flow is consistent, no bug.
Passlib emits a harmless bcrypt __about__ AttributeError warning; no functional impact (already flagged in iteration_3).
